figurative_meaning_en: In a negative sense, just mentioning the name makes everyone recognize the person
similar_in_english: Speak of the devil (in a bad context)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন একজন, ডেকো বললেই সবাই চিনে যায়।
গাঁয়ে ডেকো-এর নাম শুনলেই সকলে হাসে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a notorious figure that just saying 'Dekho' makes everyone recognize him.
In the village, mentioning 'Dekho' brings laughter to everyone's face.
note: Refers to a stereotypical notorious drunkard in Bengali folklore
